gaps: Picture in Picture: no floating video window or PiP controller API; the Settings toggle pip_auto (springboard/src/shell/options.rs:72) is stored but never read by the shell.

App-facing video player view: the SDK player() widget (springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs:900) draws audio only; the fullscreen video HUD lives in springboard/src/deildu/player_view.rs and is not reusable by other apps.
Route picker: no AVRoutePickerView equivalent for AirPlay or nearby receivers; the AirPlay & Handoff page (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs:598) is a settings screen only.
Capture: no SDK capture view or delegate (AVCaptureView); the camera is a single shell app (springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs).
Capture events: no hardware button interaction API.
Audio input picker: audiod records (springboard/audiod/src/main.rs) but apps cannot choose a microphone through a system picker.
Content proposals, trimming and display-mode switching have no counterpart.
